caveats: 307 of 3600 region grid cells are land (non-finite SST) and set to 0. 3293 sea cells were analysed. No per-cell MHW (>=5 consecutive hot days) occurred; longest per-cell hot streak was 3 days. SST exceeded the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold on only 6 days: 2017-06-15 (1 cell), 2017-06-17 (113), 2017-06-18 (117), 2017-06-19 (102), 2017-06-20 (4) and 2017-07-10 (1), so no regional MHW events were detected for 2017-06-01 to 2017-08-31.
